about: The rules of spec/engine/destruction.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: spec/probes/destruction.py on the game copy, 2026-11-22: 1,262 blueprints, 599 with PartComponentData parts (1 - 107 each; 1 part in 313, 2 in 65), 3,135 parts; object classes as above, 90 without an object instance

rules.title: A destructible part is a PartComponentData with health states

evidence.ref: spec/probes/destruction.py, 2026-11-22: healthiest state Health 0 - 100,000, most 100 x 1,545, 1 x 313, 10 x 217, 5 x 152

rules.title: A state's Health is where it begins; the healthiest is the part's start

rules.title: The last state shows nothing and plays the destruction effects

rules.title: Each health state has its own part material
